question_text: Do you maintain a current inventory of all IT assets including hardware and cloud services?
Please describe your approach to least-privilege access control for production systems.
Is MFA required for anyone accessing your cloud infrastructure console?
What is your process for revoking system access when an employee leaves the company?
Do you encrypt sensitive data while it is stored in your databases?
Do you encrypt data in transit between your systems and external parties?
Describe how often you review and recertify user access rights.
Is there a formal, board- or leadership-approved written information security policy?
Do you carry cyber liability insurance?
Have you had any data breaches or security incidents in the last year?
Is there a documented plan for responding to a security incident?
Do you perform regular penetration testing or third-party security assessments?
Are all subprocessors that touch PHI covered by a signed Business Associate Agreement?
What is your disaster recovery RTO and RPO for the production environment?
Do you test your backups to confirm they can actually be restored?
Do you background-check employees before they start work, especially those with system access?
What color is your company logo and does it meet WCAG contrast requirements for your marketing site?
Please list every country where your CEO has personally traveled for business in the last 3 years.
Is your mobile application available in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store simultaneously?
Do you require code review and automated testing before changes reach production?
Is a web application firewall deployed in front of your public-facing application?
Do you have a documented data retention and deletion schedule?
How quickly after a password is entered incorrectly multiple times does the account lock?
Is there a named individual accountable for the organization's information security program?
Do remote employees use company-managed devices only, or can personal devices also connect?
